title: Investcorp Credit Management BDC, Inc. to Merge into BCP Investment Corporation
notes: This merger is intended to drive consolidation within the BDC sector, with the combined company expected to realize immediate cost synergies, lower financing costs, and improved trading liquidity. The deal also aims to achieve operational efficiencies through larger pro forma scale and the elimination of redundant public company expenses.

title: Octave announces acquisition of Cerebre
notes: Octave is acquiring Cerebre to integrate its plant-modeling technology with Octave's engineering records, creating a unified view that strengthens industrial AI applications for mission-critical facilities. This acquisition aims to accelerate annual recurring revenue growth and expand Octave's licensing models by introducing Cerebre's capabilities to its existing Fortune 500 customer base.

title: Metalenz Acquires PxE Imaging, Expanding Its Perception Platform to Bring New Insights to AI
notes: This acquisition expands Metalenz's perception platform and addressable applications into visible light sensing by integrating PxE’s Holocoder technology. The deal leverages Metalenz's existing manufacturing and supply chain capabilities to reduce computational burdens for AI at the edge by decoding information directly in hardware.

title: Lamar Advertising Acquires Assets of Newman Outdoor Advertising
notes: The acquisition allows Lamar Advertising to expand its portfolio and strengthen its presence across the upper Midwest. The deal immediately establishes the company as the leading outdoor advertising provider in North Dakota by adding over 2,250 billboard faces.

title: ARKO Petroleum Corp. Completes Acquisition of the Business of U.S. Petroleum Partners, LLC, Expected to Contribute Approximately $30 Million of Annualized Adjusted EBITDA
notes: The acquisition aims to increase ARKO Petroleum Corp.'s scale, earnings power, and geographic presence in the Great Lakes region by adding 400 wholesale locations and approximately 280 million gallons of annual fuel volume. Synergies include enhanced vertical integration through new terminal infrastructure, improved transportation efficiency, and opportunities to capture additional margins and increase throughput.

title: GOWell Acquires WellSense to Expand Global Well Integrity and Fiber Optic Sensing Capabilities
notes: The acquisition extends GOWell’s well-integrity portfolio to include continuous distributed fiber optic sensing, allowing for more precise characterization of well problems. The deal leverages GOWell’s global manufacturing and distribution platform to scale WellSense’s diagnostic technologies.

title: Intermex Rejects Western Union’s Purported Termination of Merger Agreement
notes: Rationale not stated.

title: Virtuix Signs LOI to Acquire Defense Contractor STS International, Reporting $40 Million in Unaudited Cash-Basis Revenue Through October 2026
notes: The acquisition aims to combine Virtuix’s simulation technology with STS International’s defense experience and established government contract vehicles to accelerate market growth and profitability. The strategic rationale includes creating a platform for defense training and services while leveraging STS’s existing security infrastructure and customer relationships.

title: Danone completes its acquisition of MADE Group, expanding its presence in the fast-growing healthy nutrition space in Asia Pacific
notes: This acquisition aims to expand Danone’s presence in the fast-growing healthy nutrition market across Australia, New Zealand, and Southeast Asia. The company plans to create synergies by combining MADE Group’s entrepreneurial culture, marketing expertise, and route-to-market capabilities with Danone’s scale, science, and category expertise.

title: AdVini and InVivo continue to strengthen their strategic partnership with the proposed acquisition of the Bonne Nouvelle and Mythique brands
notes: This acquisition aims to strengthen AdVini's market position by integrating the Bonne Nouvelle and Mythique brands, enabling the company to expand its offering in the fast-growing alcohol-free wine segment and grow its portfolio of Occitanie wines for export markets. The partnership seeks to improve scale, agility, and innovation capabilities to navigate industry challenges such as declining wine consumption and climate change.

title: Cerrado Gold Acquires the Past-Producing Manantial Espejo Mine in Santa Cruz, Argentina, from Pan American Silver
notes: Cerrado Gold aims to restart production at the Manantial Espejo mine in 2027, utilizing existing processing infrastructure to achieve significant gold production growth. The company also intends to leverage its regional operating experience and relationships in Santa Cruz to support the site's redevelopment and exploration efforts.

title: GridAI Technologies Signs Definitive Agreement to Acquire Pronghorn Resources, Establishing Major Wyoming Owned-Natural Gas and Multi-Gigawatt AI Power Infrastructure Platform Targeting Initial Power Delivery in 2027
notes: The acquisition is designed to build a vertically integrated platform that uses Pronghorn’s natural gas production, infrastructure, and land assets to provide dedicated power for AI and hyperscale data centers. This move aims to ensure reliable, long-term energy availability while allowing GridAI to secure ownership interests in the AI campuses it helps develop.

title: Proposed Merger and ProVen VCT Offer
notes: The merger aims to achieve simplicity, cost savings, administrative efficiency, and increased scale to better navigate the current VCT market environment. Synergies include approximately £540,000 in annual administrative cost savings and reduced management and administration fees.

title: Proposed Merger and ProVen VCT Offer
notes: The merger is designed to achieve greater scale, administrative efficiency, and cost savings for shareholders, including reductions in management and administration fees. The combined entity aims to simplify investment management by consolidating portfolios and reducing administrative overhead while increasing liquidity and fundraising capacity.

title: Wolters Kluwer to acquire AI-powered clinical decision support platform AgileMD
notes: The acquisition is designed to integrate AgileMD’s AI-powered clinical decision support platform into Wolters Kluwer’s UpToDate solutions, facilitating expansion into embedded workflows, local guidelines, and new digital health applications. This strategic move aims to help healthcare systems improve patient care and extract more value from their existing technology investments.

title: Millicom (Tigo) signs agreement to acquire Entel Peru, expanding its presence across Latin America
notes: This acquisition expands Millicom’s geographic footprint and presence in investment-grade markets as part of a regional growth strategy. Millicom plans to leverage operational improvements and regional purchasing power to drive efficiency, improve cash generation, and expand higher-value convergent services for customers.

title: High Arctic Energy Services Inc. Enters into a Definitive Agreement to be Acquired by Newport Capital in a Go-Private Transaction and Announces Intent to Make a Cash Distribution to Shareholders
notes: The acquisition is a go-private transaction intended to deliver immediate cash value to shareholders and resolve the challenge of the company's shares trading at a significant discount to their underlying value, which had hindered the use of stock as acquisition currency. Synergies were not stated.

title: FLSmidth to acquire CE Africa, strengthening its crushing and aftermarket offering in Southern Africa
notes: This acquisition is intended to expand FLSmidth's crushing portfolio and aftermarket capabilities while strengthening its market presence and geographical reach in Southern Africa. The company anticipates revenue synergies through cross-selling, alongside efforts to scale production and accelerate innovation by combining local manufacturing agility with global technical depth.

title: Black Hills Corp. and NorthWestern Energy Complete Merger, Forming Bright Horizon Energy Corporation
notes: The companies merged to combine their complementary operations and workforces, aiming to create a stronger, more resilient organization capable of meeting the growing energy needs of their 2.2 million customers. While the release mentions an expectation of realizing projected synergies, it does not provide specific details on the nature or value of those synergies.

title: Rapid Micro Biosystems Signs Definitive Agreement to be Acquired by Merck KGaA, Darmstadt, Germany
notes: The acquisition aims to modernize and automate microbial quality-control workflows in pharmaceutical manufacturing by integrating the Growth Direct platform into Merck KGaA's existing Life Science offerings. This partnership seeks to provide customers with faster, more efficient workflows and improved data integrity to better support regulatory compliance.

title: Caliber-Sponsored Fund Acquires Tonto Oaks Apartments, Expanding Caliber’s Multifamily Holdings in Payson, Arizona
notes: Caliber acquired Tonto Oaks Apartments to execute a value-add strategy involving unit renovations and improved property management to enhance asset quality and income. This acquisition expands the company's multifamily footprint in the Payson market, leveraging synergies from its existing operations at the nearby West Frontier Apartments.

title: AMD Completes Acquisition of World Labs
notes: AMD acquired World Labs to integrate a leading AI research team and deep model expertise to help shape the next generation of its hardware, software, and systems for the open AI ecosystem. The acquisition aims to optimize compute platforms and models together to advance AI infrastructure for customers and developers.

title: Taboola Finalizes Acquisition of Dianomi
notes: The acquisition combines Taboola's Realize platform with Dianomi’s premium publisher network to provide performance advertisers with a highly specialized, brand-safe ad network focused on the finance sector. This integration aims to help advertisers reach high-intent financial audiences while offering publishers access to a deeper roster of blue-chip financial advertisers.

title: QTREX Acquires GIS to Scale Quantum Interconnect Production, Adding $10 Million in Cash and a Business with $11.3 Million in Revenue
notes: QTREX acquired GIS to bring key production controls in-house, enabling the company to scale its manufacturing of cryogenic interconnects for the quantum computing industry. The acquisition is expected to increase production throughput, improve unit-to-unit consistency, and provide the infrastructure to support upcoming commercial agreements.

title: Nutritics accelerates US expansion with acquisition of kitchen management platform Parsley Software
notes: This acquisition expands Nutritics' U.S. presence and integrates Parsley’s kitchen operations technology, such as inventory, purchasing, and production planning, into its existing food data platform. The deal creates a unified platform that aims to help customers manage kitchen operations while ensuring compliance with evolving food safety and allergen regulations.

title: WSP completes acquisition of GCM Corpo
notes: The acquisition aims to expand WSP’s Canadian platform and strengthen its core engineering consulting expertise in the energy, industrial, and mining sectors. By combining complementary capabilities, WSP expects to better support clients across the full project lifecycle for increasingly complex projects.

title: Zenta Group Signs Binding MOU for Strategic Acquisition of Controlling Stake in SE Asia-Based AI Technology Start-Up
notes: The acquisition is intended to expand Zenta Group's AI footprint in Southeast Asia and South America by integrating the target's AI computing infrastructure and AI-powered financial anti-fraud solutions into its existing portfolio. This strategic move supports the company's re-alignment toward AI and data-driven business solutions.

title: Worldwide NFT, Inc. Acquires Artificial Intelligence Platform from Discourse Analytics, Inc. to Expand Software Capabilities
notes: Worldwide NFT, Inc. acquired this AI platform to integrate advanced personalization and analytics capabilities into its existing software businesses and services. The deal aims to deepen customer engagement and create new opportunities for growth by leveraging the platform’s combination of behavioral analytics and large language models.

title: Commure Acquires Elaborate to Cure the Clinician Inbox
notes: Commure acquired Elaborate to integrate protocol-driven inbox AI into its existing healthcare platform, aiming to automate clinical workflows and reduce the administrative burden on clinicians. This acquisition complements Commure's agentic platform by providing a unified system that handles tasks from patient intake through post-visit inbox management.

title: Energy Capital Partners (ECP) Completes Acquisition of EnergySolutions
notes: Energy Capital Partners acquired EnergySolutions to support the company’s role in the nuclear energy value chain as nuclear power plays an increasingly important role in meeting the demand for reliable baseload power. The press release does not explicitly detail specific operational synergies.

title: Davion Healthcare Plc Agrees to Terms in Acquisition of Independence Care Homecare Network
notes: The acquisition provides Davion with an established multi-state homecare platform to support its strategy of building a diversified healthcare services group. By integrating these businesses, the company aims to retain local expertise and patient relationships while strengthening operational oversight and financial management.

title: Edustaff Acquires Speech Services Rhode Island to Expand Onsite Special Education Services in the Northeast
notes: The acquisition aims to expand Edustaff's onsite special education services in the Northeast by integrating Speech Services Rhode Island's established local expertise and school partnerships. This move creates synergies by combining the target's onsite approach with Edustaff's existing virtual, hybrid, and onsite capabilities to better support diverse school staffing needs.

title: NVRO Metals Completes Acquisition of Northern Territories Resources
notes: The acquisition secures an Australian site for the company to conduct the first industrial deployment of its proprietary NVRO Process. This strategic move aims to support the company's goal of building a scalable critical minerals production and recovery platform.

title: SPIE Nederland strengthens its position in industrial automation and robotics with the acquisition of Duflex B.V
notes: The acquisition aims to strengthen SPIE’s capabilities in industrial automation, machine building, and robotics while supporting its move further up the value chain. The company expects to combine Duflex’s specialized technical knowledge with SPIE’s scale, maintenance expertise, and nationwide coverage to provide more comprehensive lifecycle support to customers.

title: Rosemont Pharmaceuticals to acquire Aytu BioPharma to accelerate US expansion
notes: Rosemont Pharmaceuticals aims to accelerate its US expansion and growth strategy by leveraging Aytu BioPharma's established CNS-focused specialty portfolio and US commercial platform. The deal is expected to create synergies by combining Aytu’s commercial capabilities with Rosemont's own product development, regulatory, manufacturing, and commercial expertise.

title: Voltus Acquires Stem’s Athena Platform to Enable Battery Partners to Extract More Value from their Assets
notes: Voltus acquired the Athena platform to accelerate its ability to support commercial, industrial, and community-scale battery projects from evaluation to market integration and optimization. This acquisition aims to enable storage developers and site operators to maximize the revenue and value extracted from their battery assets.

title: Pool Corporation to Acquire Team Horner
notes: Pool Corporation aims to expand its distribution network and increase efficiency through enhanced proximity, scale, and product availability. The acquisition is intended to deepen relationships with pool industry customers by leveraging Team Horner’s established sales centers and expertise.

title: Valor Energy Inc. Closes Acquisition of 18MW Computing Center in Youngstown, Ohio, Accelerating AI Data Center Expansion
notes: Valor Energy acquired this facility to accelerate its strategic expansion into AI and high-performance computing infrastructure. The site's existing utility interconnection provides an established power foundation that may reduce certain development requirements compared to an undeveloped location.

title: Smartkem, Inc. Merger Partner Ferrox Advances Global Commercialization of Tivani Titanium and Magnetite Products Through Wogen Collaboration
notes: This collaboration aims to accelerate the global commercialization of planned titanium and magnetite products by leveraging Wogen’s international network for market development and customer engagement. The strategic rationale is to enable prospective customers to evaluate Tivani materials early, ensuring that feedback informs final product specifications and future commercial agreements.

title: Alpha Modus Announces Subsidiary's Non-Binding Letter of Intent for a Potential Acquisition of or Investment in ChainGPT
notes: Rationale not stated.

title: Clearwave to acquire Ting's owned fiber networks, expanding fiber footprint to 20 states
notes: The acquisition expands Clearwave's fiber footprint into new markets, increasing its service area by approximately 170,000 passings. The strategic rationale includes leveraging operating scale and further investment to build upon the service currently provided to Ting customers.

title: Crown Aviation Acquires Silver King Helicopters, Anchoring Its Canadian Aviation Consolidation Strategy
notes: Crown Aviation acquired Silver King Helicopters to anchor its strategy of consolidating Canada's fragmented aviation industry and building a diversified portfolio of mission-critical operators. The company aims to realize economies of scale and operating efficiencies by sharing resources, capital, and best practices across its platform companies.

title: Fernweh Group Announces Acquisition of Resource Energy Equipment
notes: Fernweh Group acquired Resource Energy Equipment to expand its industrial portfolio and footprint in the energy infrastructure market. The transaction aims to leverage Fernweh’s operational experience to support the target company's continued growth and accelerate its transformation.

title: SPIE signs an agreement for the acquisition of ENPROM Group, strengthening its high-voltage power engineering and installation capabilities in Poland and Germany
notes: The acquisition aims to strengthen SPIE’s high-voltage power engineering and installation capabilities in Poland and Germany while creating new growth opportunities in the electrical power construction EPC segment. The deal combines the companies' knowledge and experience to better address energy infrastructure needs and establish a leading market position.

title: Transom Capital Completes Acquisition of SoundThinking
notes: Transom Capital aims to leverage its operational expertise to strengthen SoundThinking's commercial execution and accelerate growth, including through strategic M&A. The deal is intended to build on the company's innovation and existing customer relationships to further advance its public safety technology solutions.

title: Synaptics Stockholders Approve Merger with onsemi
notes: Rationale not stated.

notes: The acquisition is intended to extend Trident's digital infrastructure platform into the energy layer by supplying dependable and clean power for data centres. This move aims to leverage Guang Yao’s hydrogen power and battery energy storage solutions to support the growing energy demands of digital infrastructure.

notes: This acquisition marks Exolum’s entry into U.S. pipeline operations and allows the company to offer integrated logistics solutions by combining this new pipeline transportation with its existing ammonia storage capabilities in Houston. The transaction supports Exolum’s U.S. growth strategy by enabling the company to leverage its international pipeline experience and existing local resources.

title: Willis Lease Finance Corporation Expands Fleet with Acquisition of Two Airbus A320 Aircraft
notes: The company acquired two Airbus A320 aircraft to complement its core engine leasing business and meet strong customer demand for diverse aviation assets. This strategic expansion aims to strengthen the company's ability to provide flexible leasing solutions to global airline customers.

title: AIFA Signs Definitive Agreement to Acquire Little Vault, Shanglong Li to Serve as Chairman and CEO, Accelerating AI Applications and Content IP Commercialization
notes: This acquisition is intended to advance AIFA's strategy in content IP commercialization and the creator economy, while facilitating the development of AI-powered applications. AIFA anticipates that combining its resources with Little Vault’s expertise will create opportunities to integrate AI technologies into content creation, digital marketing, and user operations.

title: Friedman Industries Expands Downstream with the Acquisition of Behrens Metalware
notes: The acquisition is part of Friedman's strategy to diversify its product offerings and expand downstream into branded, value-added metal products. It is expected to create synergies by providing a broader customer base and increased margin opportunities through enhanced manufacturing capabilities.

title: PONTIAC BANCORP, INC. AND OTTAWA BANCORP, INC. ANNOUNCE RECEIPT OF ALL REQUIRED REGULATORY AND SHAREHOLDER APPROVALS FOR MERGER
notes: Rationale not stated.

notes: The acquisition is intended to enter the defense-industrial supply-chain intelligence market and create a new commercial technology offering that generates recurring revenue through subscriptions, compliance services, and transaction fees. VisionWave plans to integrate the platform with its StratumAI architecture to develop advanced capabilities in supplier-risk monitoring, geopolitical supply-risk analysis, and procurement intelligence.

title: Base Acquires Rubiq to Give Companies Customer Context They Can Trust for AI Infrastructure and Agentic Teammates
notes: Base acquired Rubiq to integrate its customer context knowledge graph into the Base Orbit platform, providing AI-powered teams and agents with the trusted data needed for post-sale activation and lifecycle management. The acquisition enables Base to improve the reliability and accuracy of AI interactions by connecting structured and unstructured customer data.

title: Beeline and TYTL to Host Joint Stakeholder Update Call on Merger Agreement with TYTL Corp.
notes: This merger aims to combine digital mortgage origination with tokenized home equity securities and institutional capital to build a next-generation residential real estate finance platform. The companies intend to leverage blockchain technology to enhance transparency and improve transaction efficiency in the real estate market.

notes: Brookfield aims to accelerate PGP Glass's growth through an AI-led transformation program that enhances sales and operations planning, production efficiency, and quality control. The acquisition also seeks to leverage Brookfield’s scale and operating expertise to capitalize on increasing global demand for high-quality packaging.

notes: Bureau Veritas acquired Topo Solutions to enhance its digital supply chain intelligence offering with AI-powered, data-driven services. notes: International Resources Holding (IRH) views the potential acquisition as an entry point into the mineral sands commodity market, intending to integrate Kenmare's long-life assets into its global portfolio using a mine-to-market approach. The transaction supports IRH’s international growth strategy by adding a new commodity and jurisdiction to its existing portfolio of strategic minerals.

notes: J-Star Holding plans to acquire a U.S.-based manufacturing facility to establish a localized production platform for precision carbon fiber drone components. This move is designed to support scalable domestic production for U.S. drone manufacturers while leveraging a long-standing supply partnership with Mitsubishi Chemical.

notes: Rationale not stated. The company acquired the Lourdes gold-silver project to expand its precious metals exploration portfolio in Mexico, with plans to compile historical data and conduct further drilling.

notes: Roze AI intends to combine its AI fire safety technology with BAUM Architects' design expertise to drive synergies in digital architectural design, smart buildings, and sustainable solutions. The companies also aim to use this potential partnership to expand their overall market share and support Roze AI’s long-term growth strategy.

notes: The acquisition adds GrainFox’s digital platform and AI-powered tools to StoneX’s existing agricultural brokerage and risk management services. This integration aims to provide North American agricultural clients with more connected tools, market insights, and data-driven support for grain marketing decisions.

notes: Unusual Whales aims to empower the BlackBoxStocks community by integrating its own extensive real-time market data sets and developer tools into the BlackBoxStocks platform. This acquisition creates synergies by combining the data depth of Unusual Whales with the existing alerts and trading rooms of BlackBoxStocks to enhance functionality for retail traders.

title: Passage Bio Announces 1-for-6 Reverse Stock Split in Connection With the Proposed Merger With Remix Therapeutics
notes: Rationale not stated. The press release details a reverse stock split in connection with the proposed merger but does not explicitly outline the strategic rationale or synergies behind the combination.

notes: The acquisition unites two premium hunting brands under common ownership, with the companies planning to operate independently while sharing resources and expertise to strengthen both businesses. The strategic rationale focuses on a shared commitment to product quality, craftsmanship, and the hunting community, allowing Chêne Gear to provide long-term stewardship for Stone Glacier.

title: Coface strengthens its Debt Collection capabilities  with the acquisition of Baker Ing
notes: This acquisition aims to consolidate Coface’s presence in the UK debt collection market by combining Baker Ing’s specialist expertise and established client relationships with Coface’s existing capabilities and global network. Baker Ing is expected to leverage Coface's international footprint to accelerate its own development.

title: Bureau Veritas Acquires Topo Solutions to Enhance Its AI-Powered Supply Chain Intelligence Offering
notes: The acquisition aims to enhance Bureau Veritas' AI-powered supply chain intelligence offering by enabling the company to provide data-driven services to consumer goods companies and retailers. This strategic move is intended to help customers improve supply chain visibility, strengthen resilience and sustainability, and reduce risks and costs through AI-powered automation and analytics.

notes: The acquisition is designed to expand Health Partners' service offering beyond traditional occupational health by integrating ICE Creates' specialist behaviour change and prevention capabilities. This combination aims to create a broader, more comprehensive platform that leverages clinical expertise and population health initiatives to improve health outcomes at scale.

title: Gulbrandsen acquires IMACA's glass coating business
notes: By combining Gulbrandsen’s hot-end coating chemistry with IMACA’s application equipment and technical services, the deal creates a unified provider capable of offering glass container manufacturers a single partner for all their hot-end coating needs. This integration allows the companies to optimize equipment operation and enhance coating application performance for their global customers.

title: SmartStop Self Storage REIT, Inc. Expands Presence in Asheville MSA With Acquisition of Woodfin Facility
notes: The acquisition deepens SmartStop's presence in the Asheville market, allowing the company to leverage its existing knowledge of the customer base and operating environment. Additionally, the property provides the strategic benefit of in-place retail income and full climate-controlled unit offerings in a growing area.

title: CrowdStrike to Acquire Zscaler, Bringing Network Security and Zero Trust to the Falcon Platform
notes: CrowdStrike aims to unite endpoint security with Zscaler's Zero Trust SASE to create a unified platform that secures both devices and network connections. The acquisition is expected to generate $1 billion in annualized run-rate revenue synergies through cross-selling and $500 million in annualized run-rate cost synergies from operational and infrastructure optimization.

title: Texas Pacific Land to Acquire EagleRock in All-Stock Transaction, Expected to Enhance the Permian Basin’s Premier Land, Water and Royalty Platform
notes: Texas Pacific Land is acquiring EagleRock in an all-stock transaction to enhance its land, water, and royalty platform in the Permian Basin.

title: Qnity to Acquire Meridian’s Electronics Business, Expands Advanced Packaging and Thermal Management Capabilities
notes: This acquisition is designed to expand Qnity's capabilities in advanced packaging and thermal management.

title: RELEX Acquires autone to Expand AI-Powered Planning Capabilities for Fashion, Lifestyle Brands and Apparel Retailers
notes: This acquisition combines autone's specialized fashion and lifestyle planning expertise with the scale of the RELEX platform to provide brands and retailers with a unified engine for seasonal and continuous planning. The transaction aims to improve inventory performance, protect margins, and allow customers to manage the entire merchandise lifecycle through a single interface.

title: IQVIA Announces Acquisition of Quotient Sciences
notes: This acquisition aims to strengthen IQVIA's early clinical development capabilities by integrating Quotient Sciences' Translational Pharmaceutics platform to help customers accelerate drug development timelines. The deal creates a more integrated pathway from discovery through early-stage clinical development, allowing the combined entity to bridge gaps in the drug development lifecycle.

title: USFM Signs Term Sheet to Acquire Up to 85% of Hook Lake, a Fully Permitted Gold and Copper Project in Nunavut, Canada
notes: The transaction enables USFM to secure a first-mover position in a region with significant gold and critical mineral potential, leveraging its technical team and capital to advance the fully permitted Hook Lake project. The strategic rationale includes accelerating exploration at the site to capitalize on recent high-grade drill results and supporting U.S. critical mineral supply chains.

title: Mount Street Accelerates U.S. Growth with Acquisition of Seasoned Primary and Special Servicing Team, Adding $1.35 Billion Portfolio
notes: This acquisition of a primary and special servicing team aims to accelerate Mount Street's U.S. growth and expands its portfolio by $1.35 billion. The deal strategically enhances the firm's servicing capabilities and market footprint in the region.

title: Adams Outdoor Advertising Acquires 39 Billboard Faces in Western Pennsylvania from McWhorter Media Group
notes: This acquisition expands Adams Outdoor Advertising's Ohio Valley footprint and strengthens its presence across western Pennsylvania to better connect advertisers with regional audiences. The assets complement the company's existing network, providing customers with more opportunities to reach target demographics.

title: Cogent Communications Announces Definitive Agreement to Sell Three Data Center Facilities
notes: Rationale not stated.

notes: The acquisition expands Mill Steel's Midwest footprint and geographic reach while adding specialized tension leveling, slitting, and cut-to-length processing capabilities. These synergies allow the company to provide customers with shorter lead times, more competitive freight, and an enhanced portfolio of processing services.

title: Nauticus Robotics™ Signs Letter of Intent to Acquire Ocean Power Technologies' WAM-V® Business Assets
notes: The acquisition aims to expand Nauticus Robotics' autonomous portfolio into surface operations and enable coordinated, multi-platform autonomy by integrating its software with the WAM-V vessels. This strategic move is designed to deliver more comprehensive offshore solutions to customers by combining surface and subsea robotic capabilities.

title: Revive Infrastructure Group Acquires Assets of West Pacific Drilling, Inc.
notes: The acquisition aims to support record industry investment and growth by adding new customers, geographies, and high-quality crews to the company's utility infrastructure services portfolio. The partnership is also intended to help the company meet increasing demand for utility services while maintaining service quality.

title: Graham Corporation Acquires Hauschild Group, Expanding Its Global Materials Processing Platform
notes: Graham Corporation acquired Hauschild Group to expand its materials processing platform by combining complementary mixing technologies and engineering capabilities under the SpeedMixer brand. The acquisition aims to capture synergies by unifying sales and distributor networks, integrating product portfolios, and leveraging a broader global operational footprint.

title: Workday Completes Acquisition of C1.ai
notes: The acquisition allows Workday to function as an identity governance layer for both human workers and AI agents by managing access to business systems and cloud infrastructure. This integration aims to simplify access management, reduce manual processes, and enable organizations to apply policy-driven security controls across their hybrid workforce.

title: BTG Pactual Strategic Capital Finances Bertram Capital's Acquisition of Medical Technology Associates
notes: The acquisition is intended to position Medical Technology Associates for its next phase of growth through the guidance and operational support of Bertram Capital. Specific synergies were not stated in the press release.

notes: This acquisition expands Authentic's presence in the action and outdoor sports market, creating new growth opportunities across content, experiences, and global commerce by leveraging Authentic's platform and network of partners.

notes: This acquisition expands Saragon's edge infrastructure footprint into three new regional markets, enabling the company to more efficiently deliver capacity to customers in the Central Plains, Pacific Northwest, and Mountain West. The facilities were selected to leverage specific strategic advantages, such as Omaha’s established network interconnection, Tacoma’s proximity to Seattle, and Cheyenne’s position within a growing data center corridor.

notes: The acquisition expands Barnes Aerospace's turbine and compressor airfoil manufacturing capabilities while strengthening its European footprint. This strategic move leverages JJ Churchill's engineering expertise and existing customer relationships to support Barnes's strategy of growing its original equipment manufacturing business.

title: Madison Dearborn Partners to Acquire Peli BioThermal, a Trusted Cold Chain Solutions Provider, from Pelican Products and Platinum Equity
notes: This investment provides strategic capital and healthcare supply chain expertise to accelerate product growth, innovation, and global service network expansion for Peli BioThermal as it transitions into a standalone company.

title: Harvest Group Acquires Good Peeps, Accelerating Growth Toward $10 Billion in Retail Sales and $2 Billion in Media Under Management
notes: The acquisition is designed to deepen Harvest Group's retail media expertise and expand its reach by integrating Good Peeps' digital advertising and AI-driven media management capabilities into its broader commerce service offering. This move aims to accelerate Harvest Group's growth toward managing $10 billion in client retail sales and $2 billion in media spend by combining startup-speed innovation with established retail relationships.

title: Ergodyne to Acquire Thersty Hydration Products Ltd., Expanding Heat Safety Portfolio
notes: The acquisition is designed to expand Ergodyne's heat safety portfolio by integrating Thersty's electrolyte hydration products into its existing line of cooling, hydration, and shade solutions. This creates a comprehensive heat stress management stack for workers from a single provider.

title: Alta Equipment Group Agrees to Acquire Jackson Group Peterbilt in Proposed Transformative Deal
notes: The acquisition is intended to create a scaled, coast-to-coast dealership platform by adding a commercial truck vertical, which is expected to enhance recurring aftermarket revenue and strengthen the company's cash generation capacity. The deal is also projected to improve the company's capital efficiency and support long-term deleveraging.

notes: Linamar is acquiring Genie to expand its Access Work Platforms group and diversify its industrial segment through complementary products, geographic reach, and manufacturing capabilities. notes: Terex is divesting its Aerials segment to shift its portfolio away from cyclical mining and construction markets toward more resilient essential services markets. The company plans to use the net proceeds to reduce debt, return capital to shareholders, and support growth investments, though specific operational synergies were not stated.

title: Uniform Advantage Expands Retail Presence with Acquisition of 16 Former Scrubs & Beyond Locations
notes: The acquisition is designed to expand the company's brick-and-mortar retail footprint, allowing it to provide healthcare professionals with continued access to uniforms in local communities. This move leverages existing locations to bring the brand's exclusive and national product offerings directly to customers who prefer in-person shopping.

title: Platinum Equity Completes Acquisition of EDP
notes: Platinum Equity intends to leverage its operational expertise and resources to support EDP’s growth through continued investments in sales, marketing, technology, and strategic acquisitions. The firm aims to utilize its experience in route-based and multi-site businesses to drive value by expanding the company’s geographic footprint and deepening customer relationships.

title: Sanofi to Acquire Insmed in Strategic Step that Strengthens Long-Term Future
notes: This acquisition is a strategic move to strengthen Sanofi's immunology and rare disease portfolio while expanding its presence in respiratory diseases. By combining Insmed's commercial products and pipeline with Sanofi's global reach and scientific expertise, the deal aims to accelerate long-term growth and increase patient access to key therapies.

title: Ascentium Acquires Statura, Expanding Its Private Client Business Across Europe and the Middle East
notes: The acquisition strengthens Ascentium's private client capabilities and expands its geographic footprint across Europe and the Middle East to better support ultra-high-net-worth individuals. By integrating Statura's expertise in international tax, trust administration, and multi-family office services, the deal enhances the group's cross-border service offerings within the Asia-Middle East-Europe wealth triangle.

title: Healthcare Holding Schweiz acquires share in FOCS
notes: The acquisition is intended to expand Healthcare Holding Schweiz’s Surgical Solutions platform with a specialized portfolio of cardiovascular surgery products. By adding FOCS’s expertise in this area, the company aims to complement its existing medical technology offerings.

title: Viomi Technology Appoints Zhigang (Sam) Yang as Chief Financial Officer and Enters into Agreement to Acquire Brondell Inc.
notes: The acquisition of Brondell Inc. is intended to complement Viomi's home water solutions and extend the company's reach in the North American home wellness market.

title: Monroe Capital Supports Waveborn’s Acquisition of Jake Rosen Entertainment
notes: Rationale not stated. Monroe Capital provided financing to support Waveborn’s acquisition of Jake Rosen Entertainment, but the press release did not outline specific strategic goals or synergies.

title: Pursuit Signs Agreement to Acquire Sky Adventures, Advancing Growth Plans in Costa Rica
notes: Pursuit is acquiring Sky Adventures to advance its growth strategy of investing in experiential infrastructure in iconic destinations with strong perennial demand. The acquisition complements Pursuit's existing Tabacón resort by offering guests nature-based adventure experiences in the same region, creating opportunities for cross-marketing and deeper guest engagement.

title: Radiology Partners Completes Acquisition of Everlight Radiology
notes: The acquisition creates a global teleradiology leader by combining Everlight's international radiologist network with Radiology Partners' U.S.-based vRad platform to provide 24/7/365 subspecialty coverage. The companies expect to generate synergies by sharing technology and clinical standards across their global markets.

title: Parker Completes Acquisition of CIRCOR’s Commercial and Defense Aerospace Business
notes: This acquisition adds complementary capabilities and proprietary flight-critical technologies to Parker’s aerospace and defense portfolio, strengthening its position as a systems provider for commercial and defense platforms. The company expects to realize cost synergies by the end of the third full fiscal year following the transaction.

title: Sentinel Capital Partners Acquires GSI Group Holdings
notes: Rationale not stated. The press release indicates that the acquisition is intended to build on GSI's foundation as a global platform of complementary brands and support the company's next phase of growth, but it does not explicitly detail specific strategic synergies.

title: Post Road Management acquires Scenic & Girard portfolio in West Philadelphia
notes: Post Road Management acquired the Scenic & Girard portfolio to rehabilitate abandoned and deteriorated buildings, aiming to bring vacant apartments back into use and provide affordable housing. The acquisition is intended to restore the properties and make lasting improvements to the neighborhood.

title: DRT Aerospace, a GenNx360 Capital Partners Portfolio Company, Acquires Duke Manufacturing
notes: This acquisition expands DRT Aerospace's manufacturing footprint by adding a fuel systems center-of-excellence and introduces the company to new customers and programs. The deal serves to broaden the service offerings available to existing customers while building an industry-leading platform in the aerospace and defense supply chain.

title: Harbourfront Wealth to Acquire JC Clark, Strengthening Its National Wealth Management Platform
notes: This acquisition aims to strengthen Harbourfront Wealth’s national wealth management platform and advance its goal of building a leading independent wealth firm in Canada. The deal provides JC Clark with access to broader resources, technology, and wealth management capabilities to enhance the client experience while maintaining their existing investment strategies.

title: Cosette Pharmaceuticals® Establishes Oncology Franchise Through Acquisition of MARGENZA® (margetuximab-cmkb) from TerSera® Therapeutics
notes: The acquisition establishes an oncology franchise for Cosette Pharmaceuticals, providing a platform to expand its therapeutic focus and advance its long-term growth strategy. The company intends to leverage this foundation to build a broader presence in the oncology space while ensuring continued patient access and support.

title: LiveChain Completes Acquisition of MIT-Originated Humanyze Assets, Positioning it for the Next Frontier of Enterprise AI
notes: LiveChain acquired Humanyze’s workforce intelligence software assets to combine research-driven organizational analytics with emerging AI capabilities. This acquisition aims to develop intelligent systems that optimize collaboration between humans and AI agents, enabling enterprises to improve organizational performance and identify inefficiencies.

title: Shift4 Completes Acquisition of Paramount Commerce
notes: This acquisition expands Shift4’s Canadian presence and integrates real-time account-to-account payment capabilities to enhance its global platform. The deal leverages Paramount Commerce’s specialized gaming expertise and payment infrastructure to provide enterprise merchants with faster, more frictionless transaction flows.

title: BlackSky Acquires EpochGeo to Expand Real-Time Intelligence Capabilities with AI-Enabled RF, Signals and Multi-Source Analytics
notes: The acquisition expands BlackSky's real-time intelligence capabilities by integrating EpochGeo’s AI and machine learning expertise in fusing diverse data sources, such as RF and signals intelligence, into its existing offerings. This strategic move aims to deliver more comprehensive intelligence products to defense and national security customers while accelerating the adoption of BlackSky's analytics services.

title: Wellable Acquires Givhero's Employee Well-Being Business
notes: The acquisition enables Wellable to expand its corporate wellness customer base and provide these new clients with access to its broader ecosystem of rewards, recognition, and holistic health services. Additionally, the transaction allows Givhero to focus its operations and technology specifically on nonprofit fundraising, corporate social responsibility, and volunteering initiatives.

title: Cerberus to Acquire the U.S. Space Systems Business of Airbus
notes: Cerberus intends to invest in the company's engineering organization, product portfolio, and U.S. supply chain to build a leading independent, U.S.-owned satellite platform that can scale to meet growing national security and commercial mission requirements. The acquisition aims to expand the business's capabilities and solidify its role as a trusted merchant supplier by establishing dedicated U.S. ownership.

title: Stratix Acquires DMI's Managed Mobility Services Business
notes: The acquisition adds expanded logistics, help desk capabilities, and a new Chicago depot to Stratix's portfolio, enhancing its reach and depth across the enterprise device lifecycle. The transaction combines the teams and enterprise customer relationships of both companies to strengthen their support for comprehensive managed mobility programs.

title: Revau Advanced Underwriting Announces Acquisition of H.W. Kaufman Group’s Canadian MGA and Claims Business, Burns & Wilcox Canada, Strengthening Its Presence in Canada
notes: The acquisition aims to strengthen Revau's position as a leading independent MGA in Canada by expanding its distribution network, specialty underwriting capabilities, and claims team. This transaction leverages the target's established presence to enhance national scale while creating opportunities to cross-sell products and expertise to a broader broker base.

title: Intune Physical Therapy Acquires Kinect Physiotherapy, Further Expanding Its Presence in the Raleigh Market
notes: The acquisition is designed to strengthen Intune's presence in the Raleigh, North Carolina market and continue the company's expansion across the Southeast. Intune aims to provide the acquired practice with scalable back-office operations, clinical support, and investments in technology and infrastructure to support long-term growth.

title: Applied Systems Acquires Tailwind
notes: Applied Systems acquired Tailwind to integrate AI-powered document and data retrieval into its insurance management systems, aiming to automate workflows and reduce operational costs. The combination is expected to accelerate delivery of end-to-end AI automations for insurance agencies, brokers, and carriers.

title: VIRTUS Diversified REIT Expands Seniors Housing Footprint with Acquisition of The Regency Retirement Residence in Lakefield, Ontario
notes: The acquisition is intended to strengthen portfolio diversification by adding seniors housing assets to the firm's existing mix of commercial and residential properties. Additionally, the transaction aims to achieve scale in the fund and generate immediate, durable cash flow through accretive assets.

title: Georgia Ports Authority Backs Union Pacific-Norfolk Southern Merger, Joining More Than 2,000 Supporters
notes: The merger aims to create the nation's first seamless transcontinental railroad, strengthening freight connectivity and expanding access to inland markets via a single-line rail network. This combination is expected to enhance competition, improve service offerings, and provide more efficient reach for domestic and international trade.

title: FCP ACQUIRES 2048 BOLTON DRIVE NW IN UPPER WESTSIDE ATLANTA
notes: The acquisition of this infill asset provides FCP with access to significant retail amenities and major employment centers in Atlanta's Upper Westside submarket. The strategic rationale focuses on securing a high-quality residential community that benefits from proximity to key transit infrastructure and ongoing neighborhood connectivity improvements.

title: Duravant to Acquire FlexXray, Technology Leader in Foreign Material Inspection and Recovery Services
notes: This acquisition leverages synergistic commercial opportunities across both companies' deep customer relationships and enables Duravant to expand its sorting and inspection technology offerings. The deal also integrates FlexXray's inspection and recovery services into Duravant's Lifecycle Services business while creating new channels to cross-sell technologies and services across their respective customer bases.

title: RHONDOS Completes Acquisition of PowerConnect for SAP® Solutions
notes: The acquisition brings product development and global support together under a single owner to advance SAP observability, cybersecurity, and AI-ready data capabilities. This integration aims to create a unified roadmap and long-term commitment for customers managing critical SAP systems.

title: Digi International Completes Acquisition of Disruptive Technologies, Expanding SmartSense Physical-World Intelligence Capabilities
notes: This acquisition combines Disruptive Technologies' advanced wireless sensing capabilities with SmartSense by Digi's software and analytics platform to enhance physical-world intelligence. The deal aims to expand SmartSense into new applications like building management and occupancy sensing while offering new return-on-investment opportunities for existing customers.

title: Five9 Completes Acquisition of Level AI
notes: Five9 acquired Level AI to enhance its platform with advanced artificial intelligence, specifically to provide real-time agent assistance, actionable insights, and improved customer experience automation. This strategic move aims to leverage Level AI's conversational intelligence technology to drive greater operational efficiency and quality for Five9 customers.

title: Local Bounti Becomes Largest Leafy Greens CEA Grower in the U.S. with Completed Acquisition of Revol Greens' Certified-Organic Facilities
notes: Local Bounti acquired these facilities to rapidly expand production capacity and meet high customer demand at a lower cost than building new infrastructure. The acquisition also enables the company to offer certified-organic products and establishes a stronger distribution network in the Midwest and Southern U.S.

title: Remix Therapeutics Completes Closing of Merger with Passage Bio and Previously Announced $100 Million Private Placement
notes: Rationale not stated.

title: Thor Equities Completes Acquisition of Prime San Francisco Asset for $50.5 Million
notes: Thor Equities acquired this property to expand its presence in the San Francisco market, citing the asset's prime location, scale, and flexibility as key strategic drivers. The firm aims to leverage its experience in the neighborhood and previous success in repositioning landmark properties to further develop its footprint in Union Square.

title: Pivotal Manufacturing Partners Acquires 753,428-Square-Foot Advanced Manufacturing Facility in the Dallas–Fort Worth Metroplex
notes: Rationale not stated.

title: OpenTable Announces Proposed Acquisition of Australian Restaurant Technology Company me&u
notes: By joining forces, OpenTable and me&u aim to combine their respective reservation and guest experience capabilities with a comprehensive, connected product suite to provide hospitality operators with a single, unified set of tools to manage their businesses. The acquisition allows the companies to offer a broader range of connected solutions to restaurants and enables me&u to scale its tools more effectively.

title: ValOre Metals Announces Definitive Agreement to Acquire Bemisa Água Azul Mineração S.A., Owner of the Água Azul Gold Project in Pará State, Brazil
notes: The acquisition is designed to advance ValOre’s goal of becoming a precious metals producer of scale by adding a cash-generating, open-pit gold operation and expansion project in the Carajás Mineral Province. The deal also provides strategic value through the project's exploration potential along a 15-kilometre mineralized corridor and existing infrastructure, allowing the company to scale up gold production while progressing its existing Pedra Branca project.

title: EQUASENS enters into exclusive negotiations to acquire a majority stake in Synapse Medicine, the developer of MedGPT and a pharmaceutical database
notes: Equasens intends to acquire a majority stake in Synapse Medicine to integrate its medical artificial intelligence and pharmaceutical database expertise into Equasens' existing medication management software. This strategic move aims to enhance the functionality of Equasens' healthcare solutions and accelerate the integration of AI to improve patient safety and professional workflows.

title: UK Competition and Markets Authority in principle accepts remedies in AkzoNobel-Axalta merger
notes: The merger combines two leading coatings companies with complementary portfolios, technologies, and brands to create a global coatings entity with approximately $17 billion in revenue. By integrating their operations across various coating sectors, the companies aim to leverage these synergies to enhance their market position and product offerings.
